text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Teeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Premises:
∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ Teeth(x)) ::: Some mammals have teeth.
¬Teeth(platypus) ::: Platypus have no teeth.
Mammal(platypus) ::: Platypus are mammals.
Teeth(humans) ::: Humans have teeth.
Conclusion:
Mammal(humans) ::: Humans are mammals.
